kaliwa.name: Kaliwa Route
stops: Si14 Church Among the Palms-Christian School

kanan.name: Kanan Route
kanan.note: Same loop as Kaliwa, opposite direction: Ka01 CPark-DevComm ... Ka17 CPark-Landbank. Ka06-A Women's Dorm / Ka06-B Men's Dorm on the dorm branch; Ka07 Mariang Banga and Ka08 SU on the SU branch.
stops: Ka03 Church Among the Palms-Christian School

forestry.name: Forestry Route
forestry.note: 2024 map path differs from our 2026 ground truth on the lower-campus leg (map: Sacay + Library; ours: CEM, OVCRE, Narra Bridge, Maria Makiling Statue). Upper leg is a one-way loop: up via FPRDI/Botanical Garden/Admin, around FOREHA-Makiling Trail-MAREHA, straight down Makiling Road past the Museum of Natural History.
stops: Fo06 Forest Products Research and Development Institute (FPRDI)
Fo12 Museum of Natural History (downhill leg)

up-rural.name: UP Rural High-Jubileeville Route
stops: Ru05 IRRI (interchange: IRRI Station, PNR South Haul)

up-college.name: UP College / UP Gate Route
up-college.note: Same corridor as the Calamba-Los Baños jeeps we already model as lb-to-calamba; reconcile stop names there instead of adding a duplicate route.
stops: Co03 College Junction-Olivarez (interchange: College Station, PNR)
Co05 Los Baños Bayan (near Los Baños Station, PNR)

ridingReminders: Jeepneys coming from Calamba Crossing carry a UP COLLEGE or COLLEGE signboard.
Jeepneys with a UP GATE signboard terminate at Grove and do not enter the campus.
COLLEGE-bound jeepneys may become Kaliwa, Kanan, Forestry, or UP Gate routes as they approach campus; ask the driver or check the windshield signboard.
When hailing a jeepney bound for Forestry or Upper Campus, point your index finger upwards.
Jeepneys crossing Freedom Park may pass either the Student Union or the Dormitories; ask the driver which way it goes.

Outbound jeepneys post signboards: BAYAN (LB town proper), OLIVAREZ (College Junction / Olivarez Mall), SM CROSSING (SM City Calamba terminal), CROSSING CALAMBA (Calamba Crossing), SAKAY/LALAKAY (Camp Sakay / Lalakay only).
Campus stops have no official names; names are common place names or nearest landmarks, and stops outside campus are approximate.
No official public transport route serves UPCO, Jamboree, or the National Arts Center; tricycles are door-to-door and not mapped.
rail: PNR South Haul: Calamba to Lucena; San Pablo / Lucena trips available; IRRI Station, College Station, Los Baños Station, Calamba Station are on it.
North-South Commuter Rail (Calamba to Clark Airport) under construction as of mid-2024; no trips between Calamba, Alabang, and Tutuban until done.
Metro connections drawn on the map: LRT-1 Sucat to Roosevelt, LRT-2 Recto to Antipolo, MRT-3 Taft to North Avenue.
buses: Direct buses to UPLB from Metro Manila exist (STA CRUZ via Calamba/College signboards; a direct UPLB campus trip from LRT Buendia runs on a scheduled basis per UPLB OVCCA/OVCSA).
Metro Manila terminals reachable from College Junction: LRT Buendia/Magallanes, Cubao, Alabang, PITX, One Ayala (Makati).
